no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Formerly Organovo Holdings. In March 2025 the company pivoted from clinical-stage biotech to a drug-testing services company providing 3D human tissue (NAMkind) liver and intestinal toxicology screening for external partners. The prior lead candidate FXR314 (FXR agonist for IBD/UC) is no longer being advanced internally; planned Phase 2a UC trial was not initiated. Management disclosed substantial doubt about going concern.

excluded_preclinical.reason: Phase 2a planned but never initiated; clinical development discontinued upon March 2025 pivot to services business
